name: Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Gratitude / Defining Moments'
story_html: The 2023 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Gratitude / Defining Moments', also known as 'DMP', brings back a coveted colorway of the iconic silhouette, originally paired with an Air Jordan 6 as one-half of the 'Defining Moments Pack' from 2006. Inspired by the OG 'Concord' colorway, the championship model features a white tumbled leather upper with tonal webbing eyelets and a black patent leather mudguard. Metallic gold accents highlight the shoe's branding elements, including an embossed Jumpman logo on the lateral ankle and a '23' stamped on the heel tab. The sneaker sits atop a Phylon midsole, supported by a carbon fiber shank plate and a translucent rubber outsole.
